# Form, Backlog and Safety Checklist: ADO Simulator Backlog and Work Item Form

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of saving and conflicts, safe display, the backlog and
the boundary with the platform, for the reviewer at Gate 2 (plan review)
**Created**: 2026-11-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Saving

- [ ] CHK001 - Is "only the changed fields" defined precisely (compared with the values at the revision the form was opened at, not with the current values)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is clearing a field (an empty input) specified as removing the value, and is that consistent with the platform's reading of an empty decision (ignored)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, 016 contracts/inbound-rules.md]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the behaviour defined when the decision and a platform-owned field are saved together (one update: the platform reverts one and reads the other)? [Coverage, Spec §US5]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is it specified what the form shows right after a save while the platform has not answered yet (the saved values, no pending marker)? [Gap, Spec §US1-3]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are HTML fields edited as plain text and saved escaped (research R-02), and is that consistent with showing them formatted (FR-005)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-005]

## Safe display

- [ ] CHK006 - Is the allow-list of tags and attributes in FR-005 complete and closed (no "such as")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is "a web address" for FR-006 defined (only values that are wholly an http or https address, not addresses inside text)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the treatment of comments specified (always text, never formatted), and consistent with ADO, which formats comments? [Consistency, Spec §US4-4, §FR-007]

## Backlog

- [ ] CHK009 - Is the order of children (by id) and the treatment of items whose parent is outside the area filter specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, §US3-3]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are items of other types without a parent (not of the board type) shown, or excluded? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the depth of the tree bounded, and is a link cycle (impossible through the API) still guarded against in display? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-009]

## Boundaries and data

- [ ] CHK012 - Is the requirement that the seed's decision values and the tracker mapping's agree stated with its check (a platform test reading both files), and is the direction of change defined (the mapping leads)? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions, research R-03]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is a seed without a `form` section a supported case (one section with every field)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is SC-006 (the full lifecycle from the pages) measurable within this feature, or does it depend on the demo rehearsal (020), and is that stated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
